model: Acti 9 Smartlink Modbus (A9XMSB11) 11-channel I/O and pulse concentrator
applies_to: Acti 9 Smartlink Modbus RS-485 module A9XMSB11, per user manual DOCA0004EN-06 (04/2016).
summary: The Acti 9 Smartlink gathers status, commands and pulse counts from up to 11 Ti24 channels (iOF+SD24 auxiliaries, iACT24/iATL24, Reflex iC60, RCA iC60, pulse meters such as iEM2000T) and serves them on one Modbus RTU address. Summary blocks give all channels in one read; each channel also has a 40-register detail block. 32-bit counters are big-endian.

addressing.note: The manual prints Modbus protocol addresses, which start at 0, and says a master that uses data-model numbering must add 1. Its frame example reads address 14050 as 0x36E2.

source.title: Acti 9 Smartlink Modbus Communication System - User Manual
source.pages: Comms settings pp. 63-64; data types and big-endian rule pp. 74-75; frame example p. 76; address overview p. 77; system and summary registers pp. 79-83; channel detail pp. 84-89; configuration registers p. 90

notes: The manual states 32-bit values are big-endian: most significant word first.
Channel n detail registers = channel 1 register + 40 x (n-1) (14200, 14240 ... 14600). Only channel 1's detail block is listed here; the summary blocks 14000-14165 cover all channels.
Power/flow and consumption units depend on the meter on that input (Wh, m3, L ...), set by its pulse weight. The flow value drops to 0 when pulses stop.
Left out: identification strings (100, 109), date/time (115) and counter setting dates (DATE type), and the embedded configuration blocks beyond the channel 1 product type.
The Smartlink adapts to the master's baud and parity after up to 25 frames at power-up; with no parity it needs 2 stop bits.

integration.summary: Read 120-121 for all input states, 14050-14093 for every channel's energy/pulse totals and 14000-14043 for rates; write bits in 130/131 to open or close Acti 9 devices.
integration.enable: Set the Modbus address (01-99) on the two thumbwheels. Speed, parity and stop bits are picked up from the master automatically at power-up.
quirks: Order bits are cleared by the Smartlink once executed.
In a channel order register (14201 / 14202), setting bit 0 and bit 1 together has no effect.
setup: Default 19200 baud, even parity, 1 stop bit; 4800 and 9600 also supported.
Factory reset: power off, set address 00, power on.
gotchas: Pulse weights default to 10; set 14230/14231 per channel to match the meter.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
